name: github-pages
description: Publishes the site's static export to GitHub Pages with the workspace's own saved token. Ships the host code itself (Tovu loads it only because Tovu shipped it) and the know-how an agent needs: which token permissions to grant, never guessing the owner, the address and base path, and what each failure means in plain words.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Puts your website online on GitHub Pages. The assistant shows you a preview first.
